Proves AR-6's `in` operator on a `datetime` field (AR-7) when the Set Filter's `values` use the zone-less spelling AG Grid emits for date conditions, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` (SEM-4, SEM-5; Bug #2319): the adapter resolves each value with `requestContext.zone` (UTC) into an absolute instant, so the artifacts are identical to case 052's, which spells the same members as ISO instants. Per SQL-4 Postgres casts the set array, `"created_at" = ANY($1::timestamptz[])`; the seed rows sit at `.000Z` and `.001Z` around each member to prove millisecond precision; SEM-2: `in` never matches null.
